psychological_meaning: Woodrush evokes feelings of earthiness, stability, and understated elegance. It provides a sense of grounding and connection to nature, often associated with reliability and quiet strength. This color suggests a mature and sophisticated sensibility, leaning towards natural comfort and enduring style.
